# Hexagon preprints

The PDFs and six source ZIP files are distributed under [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Original files are reproduced unmodified. The local reader displays rendered copies of the pages.

Hexagon credits Will Howe, Grant Huffman, Jensen Kohlmeyer, and Liam Kruer on each work below.
